luogu.title: Sign in with Luogu
luogu.description: Use a CP OAuth account linked to this Luogu UID.
luogu.uidHint: The number in your Luogu profile URL.
luogu.uidRule: Enter digits for a Luogu UID.

register.title: Create account
register.description: Your username appears on your public profile.
register.usernameRule: 3–24 characters: lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
register.exists: This username or email is already in use.
register.closedText: New registrations are currently paused. Existing accounts can still sign in.

description.luogu: Verify your Luogu account with a public clipboard to link it on sign-up.
description.leetcode: Verify your leetcode.cn account via its bio to link it on sign-up.

uidHint.luogu: The number in your Luogu profile URL.
uidHint.leetcode: The part after /u/ in your leetcode.cn profile URL.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.description: Enter your account email to receive a 30-minute reset link.
forgot.sentText: If {email} matches an account, a reset link has been sent.

reset.title: Set new password
reset.description: All active sessions will be signed out after the reset.
reset.invalidText: Reset links work once and expire after 30 minutes.

verified.successText: All sessions were signed out. Sign in again to continue.
verified.expiredText: Request a new verification email from your profile.
verified.conflictText: Another account already verified this email address.
verified.errorText: Request a new verification email from your profile.
